versions.changelog:
Initial release of macos-memory-triage, a skill for safe memory diagnostics and process cleanup on Mac.

- Provides step-by-step memory triage for diagnosing slow or unresponsive Macs, focusing on swap and memory usage.
- Identifies process bloat from AI tools, Electron IDEs, and orphaned/background processes.
- Guides safe clearing of regenerable caches (never deletes/uninstalls anything).
- Ensures every remediation step is user-reviewed and reversible; clearly warns before stopping any process.
- Explains how to handle persistent/restarting processes and how to disable plugins/extensions safely.
